sections.headline: Fresh Windows 11
sections.subline: on a real Surface. Straight from Microsoft.
sections.voice_text: This Surface is now running a completely fresh copy of Windows 11. No bloatware, no old files, and it came straight from Microsoft.

sections.title: Create the recovery drive
sections.voice_text: Plug in your USB drive. Search for recovery drive, and open Create a recovery drive. Uncheck Back up system files. Choose your USB drive, and click Create.

sections.title: Copy the files to the USB
sections.voice_text: When it finishes, open the zip file you downloaded, and extract everything onto the USB drive. This can take a while. A fast USB 3 drive helps a lot.
